title: paneion
intro: Paneion, commonly known as the "Feverfew" plant, is a flowering perennial plant that belongs to the daisy family. This plant is widely recognized for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate headaches and migraines, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Paneion include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and volatile oils. The bioactive constituents of Paneion have been found to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties, further solidifying its importance in traditional medicine.
